## Featured Publications

:::::: {style="display: flex; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap;"}
::: {.feature-card style="flex: 1; min-width: 250px;"}
**[Tick-Borne Disease Prevention in Long-Distance Appalachian Trail Hikers: A Health Belief Model Approach](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42334346/)**

<p><em>Wilderness & Environmental Medicine</em></p>

<p>Explores how long-distance Appalachian Trail hikers understand and practice tick-borne disease prevention, using the health belief model to examine the beliefs behind their behaviors.</p>

<p>[Read the paper →](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42334346/)</p>
:::

::: {.feature-card style="flex: 1; min-width: 250px;"}
**[Eco-anxiety, climate concern, and fatalistic outlooks: Insights from U.S. crisis text conversations on climate distress](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40452860/)**

<p><em>The Journal of Climate Change and Health</em></p>

<p>A qualitative analysis of U.S. crisis text conversations mentioning climate change, identifying common emotional responses and coping strategies tied to climate distress.</p>

<p>[Read the paper →](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40452860/)</p>
:::
